serp.note: 8-tool 2026 one-person-company guide from Soleur. Tools: Claude Code, Cursor, Linear, Vercel, Supabase, Stripe, Perplexity, Soleur. ~1,800 words. H2s: how to evaluate / the best tools / beyond tools / the stack worth running / FAQ. Core thesis: whole-job coverage over single-purpose tools.

Thin 4-tool round-up (Rocket.new, Notion AI, Jasper, ChatGPT) with no 2026 pricing. Sections are high-level (why AI, trends, top tools, how AI improves business). Positions Rocket.new's app-builder. Weakness: no prices, no decision framework.

9-tool breakdown with verified 2026 pricing: ChatGPT Plus $20, Claude Pro $20, Canva AI free-$13, Zapier free-$19.99, Notion AI $10-$20, Cursor $20, n8n free self-host, Perplexity free-$20, QuickBooks $20. Complete stack $75-$150/mo replacing $600-$1,000/mo in VA cost. 9 H2s, ~3,300 words.

15-agent ranking: Founderr $49-99, CrewAI free-$99, Relevance AI usage, Lindy AI usage, Sintra AI $39-97, MindStudio, Gumloop ~$37, Manus AI, n8n, Make, Zapier Agents, Taskade AI, Bardeen, Cognosys, AgentGPT. Positions Founderr #1 for solo-founder fit (flat pricing). Build-your-own picks: CrewAI + Lindy.

5-tool lean stack: Folk CRM $30+, Lindy $49.99+, Relay.app free-$38+, Tana free-$10, Motion $29+. Total ~$100-150/mo. Framework: 'A lean AI stack has five layers. Not ten. Not three. Five.' Explicit anti-bloat thesis — our 5-tool structure borrows this operational-layer framing.

Layered 2026 stack guide: Claude ~$20/Max $100-200, ChatGPT ~$20, Gemini ~$20, Cursor free-$20 (now outdated — new tier is $8/30/100/200), Lovable $25-29, Replit Agent $10-25, GitHub Copilot $10-19, Lindy from $50, n8n cloud from $20, Relevance AI $20-30, Retell/ElevenLabs usage-based. 9 H2s.

13-tool review: Storyflow $7.99-39, Framekit free-$39, ChatGPT free-$30, Notion AI ~$10, Claude free-$20, ClickUp Brain ~$7+add-on, Apollo+Clay+Smartlead $49+$134+$39, Reflect ~$10, Jasper ~$39, Intercom Fin per-resolution, Sudowrite ~$10, Mem ~$15, Cursor free-$20 (outdated).

Category-based 10-category breakdown: general assistants (Claude/ChatGPT ~$20), coding (Cursor ~$20 outdated), app builders (Lovable/Bolt/v0 $15-30), research (Perplexity ~$20), design (Canva Pro ~$15), image gen (MJ $10-30), knowledge (Notion ~$10-20), meetings (Otter/Granola $10-20), automation (Zapier/Make ~$20+). 13 H2 sections. Three-tool minimum framing — we borrow this.

5-tool opinionated stack: OpenClaude $0-200, Mem Free $0, Bland AI ~$0.02/min, Arc Browser $0, Lovable $0-49. Phased 3-month adoption. Total <$250/mo for 'one-person company that runs like a 10-person company.' Short-list format (criteria/short-list/deep-dive/what-didn't-make-it/stack).

12-tool breakdown with verified pricing: ChatGPT Plus $20, Claude Pro $20, Jasper $39, Notion AI $10, Canva Pro $12.99, Zapier free-$29.99, Make free-$9, QuickBooks+Intuit $30, Descript $12, Copy.ai $36, Tidio free-$29, Pecan AI custom. Three starter stacks ($43/$56/$75-150 bands). Budget-conscious $43/mo band — we use this bucketing.

PRIMARY SOURCE. Claude pricing page verified Nov 13, 2026. Free: $0, Pro: $17/mo annual ($200 up front) or $20/mo monthly, Max: $100/mo, Team Standard: $20/seat annual or $25/mo monthly. Explicit 'Price and plans are subject to change at Anthropic's discretion.' Used for all Claude figures.

PRIMARY SOURCE. Zapier pricing verified Nov 13, 2026. Free: $0/mo (100 tasks/mo). Professional: $19.99/mo annual (750 tasks) · $49/mo (2,000 tasks) · $89/mo (5,000 tasks). Team: $69/mo annual (2,000 tasks). Annual billing = 33% off monthly. Used for all Zapier figures.

PRIMARY SOURCE. Cursor pricing verified Nov 13, 2026. Free: $0, Plus: $8/mo, Premium: $30/mo (Most popular), Super: $100/mo, Ultra: $200/mo. Teams: $30+/user/mo. NOTE: 2026 restructure from old flat $20 Pro — most earlier 2026 solo-founder reviews (Padron, Storyflow, TechPluto) still quote outdated $20.

structure_choice.why_different_from_previous_2: Previous 2 posts used 비교선택 (best-ai-writing-tools-for-bloggers) and 결론먼저 (is-chatgpt-plus-worth-it-for-work). This post frames the task as a four-jobs-on-40-hours problem that a specific 5-tool stack solves — a problem-solving structure distinct from head-to-head comparison or pure conclusion-first.

gaps.gap: Reviews quote outdated Cursor pricing (flat $20 Pro) — the 2026 restructure to $8/$30/$100/$200 tiers is missed by Padron, Storyflow, and TechPluto.
gaps.covered_in: Shipping product: Cursor, Lovable, and v0

gaps.gap: The common 3-mistake waste pattern ($168-$379/month in avoidable spend) is named across reviews but never quantified in one place for solo founders.
Top results list tools but rarely specify the sequence — which tool is bought first, second, third — and the category-specific second-tool decision.
gaps.covered_in: Which AI tool matters first (the fastest-ROI decision)

gaps.gap: Reviews describe stacks in features but skip the underlying problem (four jobs on 40 hours) that defines solo-founder AI ROI.
gaps.covered_in: The problem AI actually solves for solo founders

overlap_ok: Different audience and workflow: solo founders buy SaaS at commercial pricing to replace a 4–5 person team across product/marketing/ops/sales; graduate students pick academic-corpus tools (Elicit, Consensus, NotebookLM, Zotero) with student discounts for literature review, source-grounded notes, and thesis drafting — zero tool overlap in the two stacks and zero overlap in the buying question (ROI on revenue vs. defensible citations).
